The mark remains an overlay so it cannot shift bubbles horizontally, while its owner row reserves the mark's height to prevent an empty streaming reply from clipping at the transcript live edge.

Apps search now owns an explicit unknown/loading/completed/failed presentation state so the UI never flashes a false empty result before filtering completes.

Home ask bar now auto-grows as a multi-line TextField so long messages wrap instead of scrolling off-screen; the Home prompt rail also receives the ask bar's outer trailing edge so the custom rail aligns flush with it; a component split is tracked follow-up.

The Canonical Memory Atlas owns progressive disclosure, island territories and captions, selection-trail Escape behavior, in-place evidence inspection, and related render policies. Geometry and territory labels are extracted where possible; a further surface split remains tracked separately.

Relatedness layout, Louvain neighbourhood detection, and the group-separation and anchor-repulsion forces the island map is built on; no baseline entry existed because the file crossed the threshold in this change. It is already separate from the atlas view — a further split of detection from simulation is tracked follow-up.
